title: 考研英语二 2010 年 · 阅读理解 Part A (Text 1-4)

passages.title: Text 1 · 经济管理
paragraphs: The longest bull run in a century of art-market history ended on a dramatic note with a sale of 56 works by Damien Hirst, "Beautiful Inside My Head Forever", at Sotheby's in London on September 15th 2008. All but two sold, raking in £70.5m ($127m), a record for a sale by a single artist. It was a last hurrah. As the auctioneer called out bids, in New York one of the oldest banks on Wall Street, Lehman Brothers, filed for bankruptcy.

The world art market had already been losing momentum for a while after rising for seven years, and the crash of Wall Street had a profound impact. At the end of November that year the world's most lucrative art market had its worst fall in over a decade at Sotheby's and Christie's New York sales of contemporary art. That was followed by an auction at Phillips de Pury in London, where almost a third of the works remained unsold.

In the weeks and months that followed Mr. Hirst's sale, spending on contemporary art plunged by as much as 80%. An auction in London of contemporary art in February 2009 by Sotheby's brought in less than a third of the previous year's total. It was clear that the speculative bubble had burst.

Within weeks the world's two biggest auction houses, Sotheby's and Christie's, had to pay out nearly $200m in guarantees to clients who had placed works for sale with them. They had promised minimum prices, known as "guarantees", in order to win consignments. That put the auction houses in serious financial trouble. Since then, they have all but abandoned guarantees.

Almost everyone who was interviewed for this special report said that the art market would eventually recover, though opinions differed about how long it would take. While some collectors saw the downturn as a buying opportunity, others decided to wait until confidence returned. In the meantime, the art world had to adjust to a new reality of lower prices and fewer transactions.

translations: 艺术品市场历史上一个世纪以来最长的一轮牛市，随着2008年9月15日达米安·赫斯特在伦敦苏富比拍卖行举行的“我脑中永恒的美丽”专场拍卖——56件作品的戏剧性落槌而告终。除两件外全部成交，吸金7050万英镑（约1.27亿美元），创下单一行艺术家的拍卖纪录。然而这只是最后的狂欢。当拍卖师叫价时，华尔街最古老的投行之一雷曼兄弟正在纽约申请破产。
全球艺术品市场在持续繁荣七年之后，此前已显出增长乏力的疲态，而华尔街的崩盘更是带来了深远冲击。同年11月底，全球最吸金的艺术品市场在苏富比和佳士得的纽约当代艺术品拍卖会上遭遇了十余年来最惨烈的暴跌。紧随其后的是伦敦富艺斯拍卖行的一场拍卖，其中近三分之一的拍品流拍。
在赫斯特专场拍卖之后的数周和数月内，当代艺术品的支出暴跌了高达80%。2009年2月苏富比在伦敦举办的当代艺术品拍卖会成交额还不到前一年总额的三分之一。显而易见，投机泡沫已经破裂。
在短短几周内，全球最大的两家拍卖行苏富比和佳士得不得不向委托拍卖的客户支付近2亿美元的保底金。此前为了争夺委托权，他们曾承诺提供最低保底价格（即“保证拍卖价”）。这让拍卖行陷入严重的财务困境。自那之后，他们几乎彻底放弃了保底机制。
几乎所有接受本特别报告采访的人都表示艺术市场最终会复苏，但在需要多长时间上存在分歧。一些收藏家将经济低迷视为买入良机，而另一些人则决定等待市场信心重聚。在此期间，艺术界不得不适应价格回落、交易紧缩的新现实。

passages.title: Text 2 · 社会文化
paragraphs: I was addressing a small gathering in a suburban Virginia living room — a women's group that had invited men along to discuss cross-gender communication. A man in the group said: "My wife talks constantly. When we're driving, she talks about everything she sees. At home, she tells me about everything that happened at work, who said what, how she felt about it. Sometimes I just want peace and quiet."

He gestured toward his wife and said, "She's the talker in our house." The woman next to him turned to him in astonishment. "I'm the talker? You're the one who gave a two-hour lecture at dinner last night! You talked non-stop about politics, and nobody else could get a word in edgewise!"

The pattern was observed by political scientist Andrew Hacker, who found that in public, men talk more, while in private, women do. Men speak more in meetings, conferences and other situations where they feel the need to establish status, display expertise, or win arguments. Women, on the other hand, speak more at home or in intimate settings where the goal is to build relationships, share feelings, and maintain connection.

Instead, they focused on communication: "He doesn't listen to me." "She complains too much." Sociolinguists call these different approaches "report talk" and "rapport talk." Men use talk to preserve independence and negotiate status, while women use it to build intimacy and connection. Understanding these different conversational styles can help couples avoid mutual misunderstandings and frustration.

translations: 当时我正在弗吉尼亚郊区的一间客厅里向一个小规模聚会发表演讲——那是一个邀请了男士共同探讨跨性别沟通的女性团体。聚会中一位男士说：“我妻子总是不停地说。我们开车时，她看到什么就聊什么。回到家，她巨细靡遗地告诉我单位里发生的所有事，谁说了什么，她当时怎么想的。有时我只想要清静一下。”
他指着身旁的妻子说：“她是我们家的‘话匣子’。”坐在他旁边的妻子惊讶地转向他：“我是话匣子？昨晚晚宴上发表了整整两小时长篇大论的人可是你！你滔滔不绝地谈政治，其他人根本连插话的余地都没有！”
政治学家安德鲁·哈克也观察到了这种模式：在公开场合，男性说得更多；而在私下场合，女性说得更多。男性在会议、研讨会以及其他需要树立地位、展现专业素养或赢得辩论的场合发言更多。相反，女性在家庭或亲密环境中说得更多，其目的在于增进感情、分享感受和维持彼此联系。
然而，夫妻之间往往将注意力集中在沟通体验的抱怨上：“他从不听我说话。”“她抱怨太多。”社会语言学家将这两种不同的沟通方式称为“报告型话语”与“建立关系型话语”。男性借助交谈维护独立性并确立自身地位，而女性则通过交谈增进亲密感与情感联结。理解这些不同的交谈风格有助于伴侣间消除误解与沮丧。

passages.title: Text 3 · 社会文化
paragraphs: Over the past decade, many companies had perfected the art of tracking consumer habits. Retail giants and consumer goods manufacturers realized that if they could identify a customer's habitual routines, they could gently guide them toward buying new products. Habits, neuroscientists explain, consist of a simple loop: a cue, a routine, and a reward.

"We wanted to learn from private industry how to create new habits," says a public health official who worked with corporate marketers. The goal was to understand how products like air fresheners or whitening toothpastes transitioned from novelties into daily necessities.

Today, because of shrewd advertising and public health campaigns, brushing teeth twice a day is a deeply ingrained habit. But a century ago, few Americans brushed. Claude Hopkins, a legendary advertising executive, created the habit by linking the cue of a film on teeth to the reward of a tingling sensation and a beautiful smile.

Skin moisturizers are advertised as part of morning beauty rituals. Energy drinks have created habits around mid-afternoon slumps. Companies like Target study shoppers' purchasing histories to predict life events like pregnancies, allowing them to send coupons for baby products just when new buying habits are forming.

As this new science of habit has emerged, controversies have inevitably followed. Privacy advocates worry about the extent to which companies monitor personal behavior. Critics question whether nudging consumers into unconscious buying patterns crosses an ethical line. Yet for businesses, understanding habits remains one of the most powerful marketing tools ever developed.

translations: 在过去的十年中，许多企业已经将追踪消费者习惯的技巧打磨得炉火纯青。零售巨头和消费品制造商意识到，只要能识别出顾客的习惯行为模式，就能不动声色地引导他们购买新产品。神经科学家解释称，习惯由一个简单的循环构成：提示、惯常行为和奖赏。
“我们希望向私营部门学习如何塑造新的习惯，”一位曾与企业营销人员合作的公共卫生官员表示。其目的在于弄清空气清新剂或美白牙膏等产品是如何从新奇玩物演变为每日生活必需品的。
如今，得益于精明的广告营销和公共健康宣传，每天刷两次牙已成为一种根深蒂固的习惯。但一个世纪前，几乎没有美国人刷牙。传奇广告大师克劳德·霍普金斯通过将牙齿上的牙垢作为提示，与牙膏带来的清凉刺激感和迷人笑容这一奖赏联系在一起，成功塑造了刷牙习惯。
润肤露被宣传为清晨护肤仪式的一部分；功能饮料则围绕午后精神萎靡建立了消费习惯。塔吉特等零售巨头通过深入分析顾客的购物记录来预测诸如怀孕等重大人生事件，从而能够在消费者新的购买习惯刚刚萌芽时精准推送婴儿用品优惠券。
随着这门全新的“习惯科学”兴起，争议也随之而来。隐私倡导者对企业监控个人行为的广度与深度深表担忧。批评人士质疑，促使消费者形成下意识的购买模式是否突破了道德底线。然而对企业而言，洞悉消费习惯依然是有史以来最具威力的营销工具之一。

passages.title: Text 4 · 社会文化
paragraphs: Many Americans regard the jury system as a concrete expression of crucial democratic values: public participation in the administration of justice and trial by a jury of one's peers. Yet for much of American history, this ideal was far from reality. Juries were predominantly composed of white, property-owning men.

In some states, for example, jury duty was limited to persons of approved integrity, good character, and sound judgment — criteria that allowed local jury commissioners to exclude minorities and women at will. Even after the Supreme Court ruled in Strauder v. West Virginia (1880) that the statutory exclusion of Black men from juries violated the Equal Protection Clause, discrimination persisted through discretionary selection methods.

Although women first served on state juries in Utah in 1898, many states continued to exclude them or made their participation optional well into the 20th century. In Taylor v. Louisiana (1975), the Supreme Court finally held that women could not be excluded from jury pools, establishing that a jury must be drawn from a fair cross-section of the community.

This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors and required them to be selected at random from voter registration lists. Today, the modern jury pool is far more representative of the American populace, though challenges regarding peremptory strikes and demographic fairness remain.

translations: 许多美国人将陪审团制度视为核心民主价值的具体体现：公民参与司法审判以及接受同侪陪审团的审理。然而在美国历史的相当长一段时期内，这一理想与现实相去甚远。陪审团绝大多数情况下完全由拥有财产的白人男性所垄断。
例如在一些州，担任陪审员的资格仅限于“品行公认端正、品格优良且具备健全判断力”的人士——这些主观标准使得当地的陪审团专员能够随意排斥少数族裔和女性。即便在1880年斯特劳德诉西弗吉尼亚州案中最高法院裁定法律上明文排除黑人男性担任陪审员违反了平等保护条款，歧视依然通过自由裁量挑选手段长期存在。
尽管女性早在1898年就首次进入犹他州的州陪审团，但在整个20世纪的大部分时间里，许多州仍然禁止女性任职或仅将女性参审设为自愿选择。直到1975年泰勒诉路易斯安那州案中，最高法院才最终确立女性不得被排除在陪审员候选库之外，裁定陪审团必须从社区公正且具代表性的横截面中选出。
该项法律废除了对联邦陪审员的特殊受教育程度要求，并规定必须从选民登记名册中完全随机遴选陪审员。如今，现代陪审员候选库对美国公众的代表性已大为提高，尽管在无需理由的抗辩回避（排除陪审员）以及人口构成公平性方面依然面临挑战。
